payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a Bento Grid layout. Use: modular grid system, rounded corners (16-24px), different card sizes (1x1, 2x1, 2x2), card-based hierarchy, soft backgrounds (#F5F5F7), subtle borders, content-first, Apple-style aesthetic.
payload.best_for: Product features, dashboards, personal sites, marketing summaries, galleries
payload.css_technical_keywords: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(...)), gap: 1rem, border-radius: 20px, background: #FFF, box-shadow: subtle
payload.do_not_use_for: Long-form reading, data tables, complex forms
payload.effects_and_animation: Hover scale (1.02), soft shadow expansion, smooth layout shifts, content reveal
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Grid layout (CSS Grid), ☐ Rounded corners 16-24px, ☐ Varied card spans, ☐ Content fits card size, ☐ Responsive re-flow, ☐ Apple-like aesthetic
payload.keywords: Apple-style, modular, cards, organized, clean, hierarchy, grid, rounded, soft
payload.secondary_colors: Subtle accents, soft shadows, blurred backdrops
